userDirection: Reduce maximum stars from 5 to 3 and retune related effects because targets often die before five stacks.

tier3.damage: 2d(8+floor(I/2))+5*S against marked target; base damage only against other targets

tier5.damage: 3d(10+floor(I/2))+8*S against snapshotted marked target; base damage only against other targets

pietyMarkedKillBonus: Keep existing threshold S>=3: now requires full stacks. Other eligibility rules unchanged.
visualProposal: Approved indicator now connected to ordinary gameplay: cyan1/2 and gold3 above marked enemy.

unapprovedPassiveCandidates.starInheritance: Implemented: piety100, banked reward hit on a surviving fresh marked foe starts at2stars.

constraints: Faster full stacks are a real buff; maximum damage preserved approximately, not a balance-equivalence claim.
Keep original one-stack-per-damaging-action, exclusion, consumption, miss, expiry, friendly-fire and reward anti-recursion rules unless separately changed.
saveMigration: Legacy v1 Suisei stars ceil(3*S/5), cap3; keep already-rolled reward and preserve +5/old-star bonus of already queued comets. New Suisei payload v2. Other gods remain v1.
